title: Tableau Redirects
description: Schema for redirects.json generated by tableau_redirects_extension

from.description: Array of URL paths that redirect to the target. Directory paths include three variants (bare, trailing slash, index.html). File paths include only the exact path.

type.description: Type of redirect: 'path' for directory-style paths, 'file' for files

to.description: Target URL (absolute path or full URL)

target_type.description: Target type: 'internal' for same-site paths, 'external' for full URLs
